facts.text: Çin'deki adı, dört hayvana da benzemeyen anlamına geliyor.

en.title: This Deer's Chinese Name Means 'Not Like the Four'
en.description: Père David's deer is known in China as sibuxiang, meaning 'four not alike'. It was nearly wiped out by the late 19th century, and every deer alive today descends from a single herd in Europe. It swims well and can stand shoulder-deep in water.
